senses.gloss: 1. एष्य᳙ mfn. (see the last) to be striven after, to be sought for, AV. xii, 2, 39; 4, 16; TāṇḍyaBr.
2. एष्य mfn. (fr. the Caus.), to be examined medically or probed, Suśr.
3. एष्य mfn. (√ इ fut.), what is to come, future, Sūryas.
एष्यत् mfn. (fut. p. of √ इ) id.
एष्यत्—˚कालीय mfn. belonging to future time, future.
